Before you order

Good answers, served fast.

Everything you need to know about delivery, payments, offers and order tracking.

We deliver across our local service area. Enter your address during checkout to confirm whether your location is covered.

Most orders arrive in around 30–45 minutes. Busy periods and distance can affect the exact timing, and tracking keeps you updated.

You can pay securely by card, supported digital wallets or cash on delivery where available.

Offer rules vary. Check the details shown with each promotion to see whether it can be combined with another deal.

Once your order is confirmed, tracking shows when the kitchen starts, when your food leaves and when it is close to your door.
